claim: UDA planning material states about 90,000 employment-related daily users of Kandy, but Run17 did not locate a current formal-employment-by-sector series on a stable Kandy functional-urban geography.

metric.denominator: daily employment-related flow in UDA profile; formal sector denominator unavailable
metric.period: UDA planning baseline; exact year unclear
metric.basis: UDA city profile plus explicit Run17 evidence-gap search
metric.source_definition: daily employment flow is not equivalent to formal jobs by sector

bounded_by: No sectoral employment claim may be built from this figure until an official labour/employment dataset with matching geography is found.
notes: Required measurement record intentionally remains U.
